a: A followed `icon` used other than as a direct call is neither rewritten nor warned about, so its glyphs silently miss a trimmed build
The shadowing walk skips two scopes: a `var` in a class `static {}` block and a declaration in a TS `namespace` body don't hide the import
In dev, `virtual:weasel-icons` is never invalidated, so tables found later or glyphs added while serving are missing until a restart
`assertBundler` looks the mode up through the prototype chain
b: A `const`/`let`/`function`/`var` inside a TypeScript `namespace` does not shadow the imported `icon`
A `var` inside a class `static { }` block does not shadow the imported `icon`
Using `icon` as a value (`const g = icon`, `list.map(icon)`) gives no warning, unlike re-exports and namespace/default imports
`vite build --mode test` runs the dev path: nothing trimmed, missing glyphs not checked
`icon()` calls in Vue/Svelte/Astro SFC script blocks are skipped without a warning
The fallback scan in `collectIconRefs` drops refs, contrary to its docstring ("never drops one")
